issuing_bank.description: Name of the bank issuing the certificate.

amalgamated_with.description: Bank the issuer is amalgamated with, if printed.

place_of_issue.description: City or office where the certificate was issued.

maturity_date.description: Date the certificate is due, as YYYY-MM-DD.

currency.description: Currency of the deposit, e.g. Rand.

principal_amount.description: Sum deposited, in the certificate's currency.

principal_amount_words.description: The sum deposited written in words, as printed.

value_at_maturity.description: Value at maturity, in the certificate's currency.

term_days.description: Term in days after the date of issue.

interest_rate_percent.description: Interest rate per annum, as a percentage, e.g. 3.65.

payable_to.description: Whether the certificate is payable to the bearer or to the order of a named party, as selected on the certificate.

place_of_repayment.description: Branch where the certificate is to be presented for repayment.

signatories.description: Every signature on the certificate, by the title printed beneath it.

title.description: Title printed under the signature, e.g. General Manager.

revenue_stamps.description: Every revenue stamp affixed, by its printed value.

value.description: Stamp value as printed, e.g. R4.
